channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Sharifah Sakinah embraces 'unconventional' long-distance marriage with Cyril Kongo
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Versatile actress Sharifah Sakinah has opened up about the unconventional living arrangement she currently shares with her husband, French artist Cyril Kongo.

item.title: 'Revoke the citizenship of the 7 naturalised players'
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Calls to revoke the citizenship of the seven naturalised players are growing louder after the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) confirmed that falsification of documents had taken place.

item.title: Ekovest unit bags 54-year RM2.32bil Istana link concession
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Ekovest Bhd’s subsidiary Lebuhraya DUKE Fasa 2A Sdn Bhd has secured a 54-year concession from the government for Laluan Istana- Kiara Expressway (Like) project.

item.title: Court to hear Chegubard's appeal in Forest City casino sedition case
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The Court of Appeal has fixed March 13 to hear an appeal by political activist Badrul Hisham Shaharin, better known as Chegubard.

item.title: US judge to meet parties on Trump-tariff refunds in closed-door 'settlement conference'
item.description: NEW YORK: A US judge will meet behind closed doors with government lawyers on Friday seeking to hammer out a process to refund up to US$175 billion in illegally collected tariffs, a meeting a court official described as a “settlement conference.”

item.title: GOF detains 21 people, seizes frozen food worth RM21mil
item.description: KOTA KINABALU: The General Operations Force (GOF) Sabah Brigade has detained 21 people and seized frozen food estimated to be worth RM20.88 million during Op Bersepadu Chiller, which was conducted simultaneously in seven districts in the state on Wednesday.

item.title: Anwar yet to receive report on Azam shareholding allegations
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim today confirmed that he had yet to receive the report from the special committee investigating shareholding allegations involving Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) chief commissioner Tan Sri Azam Baki.

item.title: TNB strengthens grid for energy transition
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Tenaga Nasional Bhd is already undertaking grid planning enhancements to support higher renewable energy integration in line with Malaysia’s quest to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Haneesya Hanee: 'I've held an OKU card since primary school'
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Actress Sharifah Haneesya Hanee has opened up about her journey as a registered person with disabilities (OKU) card holder, revealing that she was diagnosed with a learning disability during her formative years.

item.title: Madrasah chairman charged with molesting three victims, including minors
item.description: TAIPING: The chairman of a madrasah, known as a ‘tuan guru’ (religious teacher), was charged at the court here today with four counts of molesting three different victims, including two underage girls, between 2022 and 2025.
